entries.name: Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — held hinge to forefoot finish
entries.sourceName: Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — held hinge to forefoot finish
entries.instruction: Main hip-to-ankle sequence transferring leg force into an upward-forward release. Hold a comfortable hinge for 2 s with long arms and a light ball. Drive hips forward and rise onto forefeet as the ball floats upward-forward; keep forefeet grounded and do not add an arm curl, second dip or lumbar arch. Let the ball land, never catch. Recovery: 90 s between complete set rounds; 20 s between individual reps; 90 s before the next exercise/section Use instead: a light-dumbbell held-hinge to rapid tall rise with feet flat, six total reps in the same 2 × 3 structure and 90 s set recovery; log no throws and no ankle finish if omitted.
